meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 在宿主和指定 agent 组的容器里装上 rtk，并往容器 settings.json 写入 PreToolUse 钩子，使每次 Bash 调用自动经过 rtk 过滤；git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令据称可省 60–90% token。
howto.when: 由操作者在主机侧执行这套安装步骤时使用；装好并重启容器后，容器内每次 Bash 工具调用都会被该钩子自动接管。

say.text: 帮我把 rtk 装到主机并挂载进 ag-xxx 组
say.note: 安装二进制并加只读挂载

say.text: 运行 rtk gain 看看省了多少 token
say.note: 输出压缩带来的节省统计

howto.what_en: Installs rtk on the host and mounts it read-only into a target agent group's containers, then adds a PreToolUse hook in settings.json so every Bash call is filtered through rtk. Dev commands like git, cargo and pytest may save 60–90% tokens.
howto.when_en: Used by an operator running the host-side setup steps; after install and container restart, every Bash tool call inside the container is intercepted by the hook.

say_en.text: Install rtk on the host and mount it into group ag-xxx
say_en.note: Installs the binary and adds a read-only mount

say_en.text: Add the rtk PreToolUse hook to this group's settings.json
say_en.note: Bash calls then go through rtk

say_en.text: Run rtk gain to see token savings
